subject: Quick check — timing & priority shift for Nimbus Labs engagement
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbuslabs.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + brief recap & next steps (Redwood x Nimbus)

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed set of next steps so we stay aligned. Attaching a one-page "NIMBUS-MAP" that maps flows we discussed and a draft SOW for budgeting.

Key takeaways:
- Primary use case: embed Redwood inference into Nimbus's search + support routing pipeline (priority: reduce latency p95 under 200ms for live search).
- Expected Q3 volume: ~30M tokens/month to start, ramp to ~120M by Q1 next year if pilot is successful.
- Security posture: must support private deployment behind VPC and KMS; SOC2 evidence requested during procurement.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) Naomi to share draft SOW + cost options (attached) — DONE (see SOW-draft.docx)
2) Nimbus to confirm procurement timeline and whether prime vendor requires a PO or contract signature
3) Schedule technical deep-dive with infra team (Jonas to lead) — propose week of July 7
4) Procurement checklist review (Marissa to assist)

Open questions for you:
- Is the budget for this initiative committed for Q3 or does approval sit in a later cycle?
- Any gating items on your side (legal, security review) we should know for scheduling?

If it helps, I can distill 2 pricing paths: (A) pilot (3 months, limited capacity) and (B) committed Dedicated pool with discounted rate — I included both in the SOW. Would you prefer a short pricing note or a joint procurement call?

Next step: would you confirm target approval window (this quarter vs next) so we can prioritize resource commitments?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: NIMBUS-MAP-v1.pdf (attachment), SOW-draft.docx (attachment)

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick note on timing — technical deep-dive availability

Alex — checking in from the infra side. If the team is targeting a July onboarding window we should lock a time for a 45-min technical walkthrough (model sizing, KV cache expectations, network egress patterns).

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Jul 8, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Jul 9, 14:00–14:45
- Thu Jul 10, 09:00–09:45

If procurement timing shifted, no problem — just call that out so we don't overbook internal engineering. Naomi, Marissa — tagging you to coordinate procurement checklist review.

Thanks,
Jonas
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

> On Fri, 27 Jun 2025 at 09:08 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > Hi Alex — quick bump on the note below. Wanted to check whether you had a moment to share the procurement timing. If it helps, Jonas and I are flexible on dates for the technical deep-dive — happy to slot something before July 11th.

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbuslabs.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbuslabs.io
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + brief recap & next steps (Redwood x Nimbus)

Hi Naomi / Jonas — apologies for the radio silence. A few internal shifts here that affect timing: leadership has put a temporary hiring freeze across product this month and finance is pushing some discretionary projects into the next quarter. That said, the project still ranks well on the roadmap — it has simply moved into the "post-budget" lane for now.

Short answers to your asks:
- Budget: not committed for Q3; finance expects to take final calls during the early part of Q4 (target window: mid-August decision, spend in Sept/Oct).
- Procurement: procurement team will want SOC2 artifacts and a standard SOW; we received your SOW draft and the checklist you attached — thanks.
- Technical deep-dive: happy to do it, but it may need to be a scoping session rather than full infra sign-off. July 21 or week of July 28 looks possible for key stakeholders.

If helpful, can you send a condensed pricing note with (1) pilot option (3 months, no long-term commitment) and (2) committed Dedicated pricing with estimated discounts at the 12-month commit level? A one-pager would be ideal for the finance sponsor.

I'll loop in procurement directly (cc'd) and propose a tentative cadence: reconvene mid-July to review scoping and then aim for final decision in mid-August. Appreciate the patience — still very interested.

Best,
Alex Chen
Head of Product | Nimbus Labs
alex.chen@nimbuslabs.io | +1 (617) 555-0219

Attachment: Procurement-Checklist.pdf (attachment)
